eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Eight
subtitle: Lesson 77 · Transactions and Error Handling

code:
IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Production.Product
    WHERE ProductID = 99999)
    THROW 50000, 'Product does not exist.', 1;
caption: Error number, message, state — raises an error just like SQL Server would itself.

code:
BEGIN TRY
    UPDATE Production.Product
    SET ListPrice = ListPrice - 1000000
    WHERE ProductID = 1;
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    PRINT 'Logging before re-raising...';
    THROW; -- re-raises the ORIGINAL caught error
END CATCH
caption: Log or react to an error, then let it still propagate up to the caller.

code:
RAISERROR('Product does not exist.', 16, 1);
-- message, severity, state — different shape than THROW
caption: Still common in existing code — recognize it, but prefer THROW for anything new.
